column1: # open-agent-robot — python files with a `__main__` block that are NOT runner nodes.
# infra/check_deploy.sh treats every `if __name__ == "__main__":` file in the tree
# as something that is supposed to be launched by infra/run_ec2.sh. That is the
# check which would have caught the `yue` defect at its source: speech/yue_server.py
# was a complete, working entrypoint that nothing in the repo ever started.
# A file listed here is exempt — but the exemption is a reviewable line with a
# stated reason, not a comment in the guard about where it need not look. Two
# further rules keep the list honest: a listed file that the runner DOES launch is
# a finding (contradictory declaration), and a listed file that no longer exists
# is a finding (stale exemption that would silently cover its replacement).
